Method of Attack: Phishing campaign using emails pretending to have insider information on President Trump's health, delivering a backdoor trojan (BazarLoader) via a malicious executable disguised as a Word document
Deployment of Ryuk ransomware following initial compromise by BazarLoader, leading to corporate-wide attacks
Phishing emails pretending to be from the Democratic National Convention (DNC) infecting recipients with the Emotet trojan
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with embedded links to Google Docs prompting download of malicious executables
Malicious document download via Google Docs link
